config.label: Browser executable
config.description: Browser executable. Chrome and Edge are auto-detected in their standard install locations; set this only to use a specific browser. A real Chrome/Edge is required for sending videos and GIFs.

config.label: Where the WhatsApp session (browser profile) is stored (default: <working directory>/whatsapp-sessions)

config.description: Phone number pairing: when set (international, symbol-free format, e.g. 4915112345678), an 8-character pairing code is logged to stderr on startup instead of relying on the QR code

config.label: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)
config.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)

config.label: Pin the WhatsApp Web version
config.description: Pin the WhatsApp Web version. Only set this if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client.

config.label: Connection health check interval in milliseconds (<=0 disables)
config.description: Connection health check interval in milliseconds (<=0 disables)

config.label: How long tool calls wait for the WhatsApp client to become ready before erroring
config.description: How long tool calls wait for the WhatsApp client to become ready before erroring

config.description: When set, additionally exposes the MCP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (Streamable HTTP) from the same process

config.description: Bind address for the HTTP endpoint (do not expose publicly; the endpoint controls your personal WhatsApp account)
